campaign_scope_note: Planned comparison: preserve ten explicitly pinned ESP32 240 MHz regulator-removed captures in their original v3 profile; acquire ten NEW RP2040 200 MHz / 1.15 V and ten NEW STM32F446 180 MHz regulator-removed cold boots using the pinned v4 silent images. This template contains no new measurements and cannot be summarized until completed.

A new v4 image hash must never be substituted into old v3 capture metadata.

completion_requirements: Acquire ten independent cold boots per RP2040 and STM32 board under the stated regulator-removed fixture; put the new captures in captures_max_clock/<board>/.
Record actual new-session environment values per board and confirm the PPK2 serial number, source setpoint and sample rate.
Fill each new capture_directories list and capture_file_sha256 object with the exact project-relative paths and SHA-256 hashes of capture_metadata.json and analysis/capture.analysis.json.
Verify the archived v4 primary images and manifest pins still match the images actually selected for acquisition. Expected image hashes alone do not attest flashed DUT memory.

Save a completed campaign JSON separately, set status to ready_for_analysis, and run tools/summarize_campaign.py with an unused output directory. Retain this pending template and the original v3 metadata without editing their measurement identities.
